name: Jewel☆Matrix
source:
Main character returns from adventure with power "matrix". It can be magically activated to attract matrix jewel girls with different respective attributes. His story of love and protection begins now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公结束冒险归来，获得了名为“Matrix”的力量。这股力量能以魔法激活，吸引分别拥有不同属性的Matrix宝石少女。属于他的爱情与守护故事，现在开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
